The check prints ALL PASS (19/19 transitions replay exactly).

| Action | Effect in `program.py` |
|---|---|
| 3 | Moves the cursor to the previous editable glyph column. It wraps from the first column to the last. |
| 4 | Moves the cursor to the next glyph column. It wraps from the last column to the first. |
| 1, 2, click | No change. |

I get the cursor positions from the x values of the glyph objects, so the rule also works for other layouts.

Actions 1 and 2 caused no change in any observed transition, so I modeled them as no-ops. I think they may change the selected glyph under conditions that the data does not show, but I could not confirm this. The header comment in `program.py` records this.
